Only public_observed_binding and v6.observed_binding.choose with their exact closed structural expectation may be qualified.

cli.stdout:
usage: write-cost-results.py [-h] [--output-directory OUTPUT_DIRECTORY]
                             [--candidate-source-directory CANDIDATE_SOURCE_DIRECTORY]
                             [--baseline-manifest BASELINE_MANIFEST]

Render only completed lot 5C cost receipts, without measuring anything. All
outcomes and figures come from the future retained 5C reports. This renderer
does not assume acceptance or copy any historical result. User-facing
timestamps use UTC−03; input receipts are not rewritten. The qualified 5C
analysis must use its predeclared generators, including their bounded
baseline-input reader. No post-measurement I/O variant is substituted. Select
a separate window with --output-directory. Source manifests are read from that
window's declaration; optional source-path arguments must match it exactly.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output-directory OUTPUT_DIRECTORY, --performance-directory OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
                        Completed receipt directory inside lot5c-evidence;
                        results are written beside those receipts.
  --candidate-source-directory CANDIDATE_SOURCE_DIRECTORY
                        Optional assertion of the candidate freeze directory
                        already bound by the declaration.
  --baseline-manifest BASELINE_MANIFEST
                        Optional assertion of the baseline manifest already
                        bound by the declaration.

cli.stderr: {"schema": "logos-engine.lot5c-cost-report-render-error.v1", "status": "rendering_blocked", "error": "ValueError: The selected window needs its retained declaration", "runtimeOrGameExecuted": false, "measurementExecuted": false}
